title: Garry Nolan debunking Atacama mummy

tellings.quote: Nolan where he got into becoming the UFO

plain: A Stanford scientist named Garry Nolan is said to have entered the UFO world by studying the Atacama mummy, a tiny mummified body found in Chile's Atacama Desert that some had called an alien, and debunking that claim. Michels points to it himself as the start of Nolan's path into the UFO subject. In the same episode he calls Nolan the man sitting on more UFO evidence than anyone alive.
